items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I replaced Dewitt Martin who was an excellent cornet player.

ctx.x: That was my little savings from my dance schools, you know, and gigs and things, playing more or less, twice, as I said, almost twice a week, I replaced Dewitt Martin who was an excellent cornet player. Excellent, but he was always drunk. You see. And it was through my savings and everything, that I managed to pay. I took two lessons. I went back a second time. Because I went to hear him play at the Hippodrome Theater and he was a very fine cornet player -- trumpet player.
Well, the Hippodrome Theater was where?
